applyTo: "**/*.fs,**/*.fsi,**/*.fsx,**/*.fsproj"

# F# Coding Standards

When writing or reviewing F# files in `finos/morphir-dotnet`, follow [CODING_STANDARDS.md](../../CODING_STANDARDS.md) and [.agents/FSHARP_CODING_STANDARDS.md](../../.agents/FSHARP_CODING_STANDARDS.md).

If the F# code is called by a C# project, also follow [.agents/skills/fsharp-csharp-interop/SKILL.md](../../.agents/skills/fsharp-csharp-interop/SKILL.md) and run `fsharp-csharp-interop-reviewer` on the diff.
